description: The playbooks a workspace has written for Monnet — a playbook is how the team wants one recurring workflow handled, and Monnet loads it when a request lands on it. Call this before writing one: a workflow that already has a playbook wants an edit, not a second copy.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: list_playbooks
